reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be a normed additive group with its Borel measurable space and second-countable topology. Fix a measurable map Phi:E x E->E,a measurable cost c:E x E->ENNReal,and an extended nonnegative factor A with A!=0 and A!=infinity. Assume the following inequality pointwise for every x,y,zeta in E:
  c(Phi(x,zeta),Phi(y,zeta))<=A c(x,y).
For every three probability measures mu,nu,Gamma on E,let the two updated laws be the measurable pushforwards
  muOut=(mu x Gamma)_*Phi,
  nuOut=(nu x Gamma)_*Phi.
Thus in each law the input and noise are sampled independently,and both laws use the same noise law Gamma. Define the raw extended-nonnegative transport cost
  T_c(alpha,beta)=inf{integral^- c dpi : pi is a measure on E x E,
                     pi.fst=alpha and pi.snd=beta}.
The infimum is over the lower-integral values of all measures having the two specified marginals. Then
  T_c(muOut,nuOut)<=A T_c(mu,nu).
The pointwise premise uses the same zeta on both compared outputs and holds for every noise value,not only almost everywhere. A is positive and finite in ENNReal but is not assumed less than one. The cost c may take infinite values and is not required to be a metric,quadratic cost or finite cost. Transport values and their products use extended-nonnegative conventions;there is no finite-cost replacement,optimal-coupling or attainment assumption. Probability normalization applies to all three laws. No Gaussian law,noise distribution beyond Gamma,iteration history,invariant law or root/power conversion is included.
objects: Normed additive-group state/noise space E;measurable update Phi;measurable arbitrary extended-nonnegative cost c;finite nonzero ENNReal factor A;probability input laws mu,nu and noise law Gamma;independent products,updated pushforward laws;raw transport infimum T_c over coupling lower-integral values.
domains: E is a normed additive group with MeasurableSpace/BorelSpace and SecondCountableTopology as given in context. Phi:E x E->E;c:E x E->ENNReal;A in ENNReal. mu,nu,Gamma are Measure E and each is a probability measure. Couplings are measures on E x E with the specified first/second marginals. Transport values and the final inequality are ENNReal,without square root or extra power. No completeness,finite-dimensionality or inner-product requirement is supplied.
quantifiers: For every such E,Phi,c,A satisfying measurability,A!=0,A!=top and the all-x,y,zeta pointwise cost inequality,and for every probability triple mu,nu,Gamma,the output transport inequality holds. The shared-noise premise is universal over all state pairs and every noise value. The transport definition infimizes over all admissible coupling measures,without an existential optimal witness.
assumptions: Phi and c are measurable. A is extended nonnegative,nonzero and different from infinity. For all x,y,zeta,c(Phi(x,zeta),Phi(y,zeta))<=A*c(x,y). mu,nu,Gamma are all probability measures. E has the normed-additive-group,Borel-measurable and second-countable structures in the approved context. No A<1,finite-cost,metric,Gaussian or finite-moment premise is imposed.
conclusion: Transport.transportCost c ((mu.prod Gamma).map Phi) ((nu.prod Gamma).map Phi)<=A*Transport.transportCost c mu nu. Both sides use the raw coupling infimum of lower-integrated c,and independent products with exactly the same Gamma.
scopes: This is a general transport-cost scaling theorem for measurable random updates,with a pointwise same-noise premise. The conclusion concerns whole updated laws,not an existence claim for an optimal coupling. Costs or transport values may be infinite;A is finite and nonzero but can be >=1. No square root,probability renormalization,moment truncation,particular algorithm,Markov-kernel assertion,iteration or invariant-law result is added. No material ambiguity is present;ambiguity is explicitly null.
constant_dependencies: The exact conclusion factor is the supplied A,with only A!=0 and A!=top assumed. A need not be less than one. The same c appears in premise and both transport terms. Updated laws depend on Phi,mu/nu and Gamma;no numerical factor,dimension constant or extra exponent appears.
